site.name: Teodor Halm
site.statement: Buildings, at the _one hour_ they were drawn for.
site.lede: **Architectural photographer** for practices, magazines and publishers. Large format and digital, based on the coast, working anywhere a building is finished.

projects.title: Reixa House
projects.outcome: Four winter mornings for the practice’s monograph

image.alt: A long low house at blue hour, its glass wall lit warm under a thin white roof, the sea behind.

case.intro: A house on a coastal plateau, photographed over four winter mornings for its architects’ monograph.
body: The house faces the sea along one long glass wall. The pictures were made in the twenty minutes before sunrise, when the room inside is as bright as the sky outside and the glass stops reflecting.

projects.title: The Salt Archive
projects.outcome: A concrete archive at its one bright hour, shot as a 12 s loop

loop.alt: A board-marked concrete archive in sun; the shadow of the building opposite slides across its windows.

case.intro: A concrete archive photographed at the one hour its street lets the sun onto it, as stills and a 12 s loop.
body: The building opposite shades the facade for most of the day. For about an hour in the morning the shadow slides back across the windows; the loop is that hour, compressed.

projects.title: Quarry Chapel
projects.outcome: Twelve-page feature and the cover of issue 31

image.alt: A dark stone room lit by one vertical slot of daylight that falls on a small block.

case.intro: A stone chapel cut into a disused quarry, lit only by one slot in its roof.

projects.title: Pier 9 Terminal
projects.outcome: Ferry terminal, opening campaign and press set

image.alt: A thin white canopy on slender columns over a wet quay, the sea grey beyond.

case.intro: A ferry terminal under one thin canopy, photographed in rain for its opening.

projects.title: Low Walls
projects.outcome: Dry-stone walls of one valley, 60 frames, ongoing

image.alt: A dry-stone wall running away across a green valley under an overcast sky.

case.intro: The dry-stone walls of one valley, photographed under the same flat sky: 60 frames so far.

projects.title: Tidal Pool
projects.outcome: A restored sea pool, shot on the lowest tide of the year

image.alt: A concrete sea pool full of green water between rocks, the sea and a low sun behind.

case.intro: A restored sea pool, photographed on the lowest tide of the year so its whole rim showed.

projects.title: Concrete Hours
projects.outcome: 128 pages; the first printing sold out in 9 weeks

image.alt: A wide concrete stair rising between two walls toward a dark doorway, a diagonal shadow across it.

case.intro: A book of concrete buildings, each photographed at the hour its architect drew the light for.

projects.title: White Curve
projects.outcome: One wall, one figure, for a gallery’s reopening

image.alt: A tall curved white wall against a deep blue sky, one small figure and a door at its foot.

case.intro: A gallery’s new curved wall, photographed with one figure for scale for its reopening.

projects.title: Timber School
projects.outcome: A school in larch, photographed in fog

image.alt: A larch-clad school building at the edge of a spruce forest, half lost in fog.

case.intro: A primary school clad in larch at the edge of a forest, photographed on a morning of fog.
